crossRefs.note: You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small.

translations.web: You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small.
translations.bsb: You shall not have two differing measures in your house, one large and one small.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not have in thine house divers measures, a great and a small.
translations.asv: Thou shalt not have in thy house diverse measures, a great and a small.
